name: disulfide Lennard-Jones trial S5 (CAPS, on OPLS-AA 2024)
notes: A trial for the liquid test: OPLS-AA 2024 gives the disulfide S 203 the sulfide S 202's Lennard-Jones (epsilon 0.355 kcal/mol, sigma 3.60 A); dimethyl disulfide came out 2.5 % too dense and 1.74 kcal/mol too strongly bound while the sulfides are within 0.35 kcal/mol. CAPS's polysulfide and persulfide S (caps_s_poly, caps_s_ssh) take 203's Lennard-Jones and move with it.
S5 / S6: from a linear fit of S1-S4 (density and dHvap of dimethyl disulfide against epsilon and sigma), a sigma below the range S1-S4 tested
